stoppingRule: Run all eight live recovery cases once. Block for exactly 20000 ms from the controller monotonic anchor; require offline queue, native probe and independent-reader checks before the deadline. Allow at most 250 ms scheduling lateness. Preserve missed deadlines and all failures. Validate full 2000-task states, pending writes, per-endpoint connection timelines, source/configuration/dependency/executable/storage bindings and cleanup. This is a correctness smoke, not a performance comparison.
